title: Among cards that are legal in the 'premodern' format and have at least one
question: Among cards that are legal in the 'premodern' format and have at least one ruling containing the phrase 'triggered mana ability', identify those with missing or unknown power (NULL or '*'). For this group, calculate what percentage also have a Japanese translation available.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.XCL_072 IN (
    SELECT fd.XCL_082 FROM foreign_data fd WHERE fd.XCL_077 = 'Japanese'
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards c
WHERE (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*')
  AND c.XCL_072 IN (SELECT l.XCL_086 FROM legalities l WHERE l.XCL_084 = 'premodern')
  AND c.XCL_072 IN (SELECT r.XCL_090 FROM rulings r WHERE r.XCL_089 LIKE '%triggered mana ability%');

    SELECT 1 FROM foreign_data fd
    WHERE fd.XCL_082 = c.XCL_072 AND fd.XCL_077 = 'Japanese'
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM cards c
WHERE c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.XCL_086 = c.XCL_072 AND l.XCL_084 = 'premodern'
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM rulings r
    WHERE r.XCL_090 = c.XCL_072 AND r.XCL_089 LIKE '%triggered mana ability%'
  );
